tools.name: get_company_information
tools.description: Get verified company, contact and handoff information for Caspar Manufaktur.

tools.name: list_materials
tools.description: List selected wallpaper materials with surface, width and primary use cases.

tools.name: recommend_material
tools.description: Recommend a Caspar material based on a project priority.

tools.name: start_project_handoff
tools.description: Return a Caspar URL for a project enquiry, material sample request or print-file check. The tool does not submit personal data.

tools.name: create_idempotent_project_handoff
tools.description: Create a safely retryable Caspar handoff record for a project enquiry, sample request or Wallcheck without submitting personal data.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: start_project_handoff · Private data: get_company_information, start_project_handoff, create_idempotent_project_handoff · Public sink: start_project_handoff.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: start_project_handoff · Private data: get_company_information, start_project_handoff, create_idempotent_project_handoff · Public sink: start_project_handoff

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
